stories.text: 🔁 Trade that should have happened: Harvey and Robinson ↔ Andrews and Croskey-Merritt back in Week 1 would have helped both sides.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Mel's Mediocre Mob leads the chopping-block odds at 42%, with Uriel's Upbeat Team next at 30%.
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: 49er Faith-Fool has 3 starters on bye this week (Brown, Jones and McPherson). Hope the bench is ready.
🤝 Rivalry week: Ramosverse leads Kirbo Crushers 4–3 all-time, and Ramosverse has won the last 2.
🤝 Rivalry week: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy leads Ruffing the Passer 4–2 all-time.
🪑 LONG-TERM REGRET: Kirbo Crushers has started Khalil Shakir just once. Starting him in Weeks 1, 4 and 5 would have meant 2 more wins by now (+27.70 pts).
🚑 INJURY WARD: Ramosverse is absolutely slammed — Smith (Rd 3), Hall (Rd 4) and Samuel (Rd 8) are out.
🎲 Ramosverse is rolling with 3 TEs (McBride, Ferguson and Hockenson) and just 2 healthy WRs. It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
🪓🎤 Bye bye bye: Mel's Mediocre Mob has 4 starters on bye (Chase, Goff, Bates and Vikings D/ST) and 42% chop odds. The guillotine loves a short-handed lineup.
🔥 Claremont In Yo Stace! has won 5 straight. 49er Faith-Fool gets the next crack at them.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 6: Brock You Like a Hurricane 29%, Gibb it to Me Baby 26%, Claremont In Yo Stace! 15%.
📈 TRENDING: Every other league is scrambling for Dameon Pierce (RB, PHI). Ours has him sitting on waivers.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
